kubejs.info.sluice_obtainable: Can be obtained by sluicing. Check uses for sluice grate for more details.
kubejs.info.blight_obtainable: Can be obtained by spreading blight with bonemeal or otherwise. Blight can occur from certain totem magic.
kubejs.info.circuit: Circuits are dropped by the Scamppanzer boss which can be summoned via a Scamppanzer Transmitter
kubejs.info.tools_lead: I think you might have lead poisoning for even thinking about these tools... You can give others lead poisoning though so it's okay!
kubejs.info.tools_steel: Diamond tier tool. Has stats between iron and diamond.
kubejs.info.tools_aluminum: Iron tier tool. Unbreakable but has stats between wood and stone plus a 40% mining speed penalty. Best used when enchanted. Useful for deployer automation.
kubejs.info.player_head: Can be used in a navigation table to track a player. Obtained by killing a player with heavy things. Can be renamed to a valid username in an anvil to change skin.
kubejs.info.polar_generator: Burns combustible fuels to generate FE. Only stops burning when internal battery is completely full and current fuel is depleted.
